title: MHeatmap: Two-Walk Laplacian Reordering and Mosaic Layout for Rectangular Matrix Visualization
abstract: arXiv:2610.29114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weighted rectangular matrices record relations between two types of objects, such as occupations and industries, documents and terms, origins and destinations, or annotated classes and computed clusters. Their heatmaps become difficult to read when arbitrary row and column orders scatter related objects, while equal size cells hide large differences in row and column totals. We present MHeatmap (Mosaic Heatmap), which addresses these problems in two stages. Two-Walk spectral seriation first represents the matrix as a weighted bipartite graph. Ordinary bipartite ordering uses only observed row to column links. Two-Walk also uses length-two walks, so rows that share columns and columns that share rows receive explicit similarity links. Sorting a Fiedler vector of the resulting graph Laplacian gives coordinated row and column orders. translated_title: MHeatmap：用于矩形矩阵可视化的双游走拉普拉斯重排序与马赛克布局
translated_abstract: 加权矩形矩阵记录了两类对象之间的关系，例如职业与行业、文档与词项、出发地与目的地，或人工标注类别与计算得到的聚类。当任意的行列顺序使相关对象分散开来时，这些矩阵的热力图会变得难以阅读，而等大小的单元格则掩盖了行总和与列总和之间的巨大差异。我们提出了MHeatmap（马赛克热力图），分两个阶段解决这些问题。首先，双游走谱序列化将矩阵表示为加权二部图。普通的二部图排序仅利用观测到的行到列的连接，而双游走还利用长度为2的游走，使共享列的行之间、共享行的列之间获得显式的相似性连接。对由此得到的图拉普拉斯矩阵的Fiedler向量进行排序，即可获得相互协调的行序和列序。随后，马赛克布局对单位正方形进行划分，使行高与行总和成比例，列（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MHeatmap方法，通过在加权二部图中引入长度为2的游走相似性连接并基于Fiedler向量排序实现行列协调重排，同时采用行列尺寸与对应总和成比例的马赛克布局，解决了矩形矩阵热力图中相关对象分散、单元格大小掩盖数据总量差异的可读性问题。
en_tdlr: MHeatmap improves rectangular matrix heatmap readability by combining Two-Walk spectral seriation—which adds length-two walk similarity links in a weighted bipartite graph and sorts a Fiedler vector for coordinated row-column ordering—with a mosaic layout whose cell sizes are proportional to row and column totals.
